lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 uses three column-specific assessment periods rather than a single window. Column b (While a Resident) — the observation window recorded here — is the last 14 days (p. O-3; item rationale on p. O-2 also calls it the "14-day look-back period"). Column a (On Admission) uses days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B, and column c (At Discharge) uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C (p. O-1 item table and p. O-3). The coexistence of these windows is recorded in conflicts.

federal.notes: Stated as the sole Step for Assessment for O0110.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages describe O0110 assessment periods in terms of the SNF PPS Stay (A2400B/A2400C) but do not state that O0110E (Tracheostomy care) drives a payment or case-mix classification.

conflicts.topic: Multiple assessment windows coexist for O0110E (14-day 'While a Resident' window vs. 3-day admission and 3-day discharge windows)

positions.claim: Column b uses a 14-day look-back: treatments performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Reevaluation of special treatments and procedures the resident received or performed, or programs that the resident was involved in during the 14-day look-back period is important to ensure the continued appropriateness of the treatments, procedures, or programs.

positions.claim: Columns a and c use 3-day assessment periods tied to the start (A2400B) and end (A2400C) of the SNF PPS Stay.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document itself: each column has its own defined assessment period, and the assessor reviews the record "within the assessment period defined for each column" (p. O-3). The 14-day window applies only to column b.
